name: set-observed-remove-three-writer
description: WRIT-345 item 6 (spec/fold.md §5.4): a three-writer OR-set shape -- add on one writer, remove causally after it on a second, re-add concurrent with the remove on a third -- where the re-add sorts BEFORE the remove in the total order L. Every prior set-observed-remove vector puts a concurrent re-add after the removing op in L, so a reducer that keyed presence off L-position (a remove kills every earlier-in-L add of the same item) passed them all; here the re-add (op-carol-readd, t*=150) precedes the remove (op-bob-remove, t*=200) in L while remaining causally concurrent with it, so only a reducer keyed off causal ancestry -- add-wins is existential over adds not superseded by a causally later remove, not over adds earlier in L -- keeps 'bug' present.
